title: Partitive Forms: Singular, First patterns review
focus: Retrieve the singular formation patterns taught in this pack.

exercises.prompt: Choose both singular partitives: talo (“house”) and lelu (“toy”).
exercises.explanation: Keep talo and add -a: talo + a = taloa. Keep lelu and add -a because u is a back vowel: lelua.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Regular singular partitive: -a/-ä: form or use confused

optionFeedback.taloa, lelua: Keep talo and add -a: talo + a = taloa. Keep lelu and add -a because u is a back vowel: lelua.
optionFeedback.talo, lelua: The first word is still the dictionary form. Keep talo and add -a: talo + a = taloa.
optionFeedback.taloa, leluä: The second word is not formed correctly. Keep lelu and add -a because u is a back vowel: lelua.

exercises.misconceptionCategory: Singular partitive: -ta/-tä: form or use confused
